description: This file defines the BuzzPhotoController class which extends an abstract file controller to handle HTTP requests related to BuzzPhoto entities in the OrangeHRM system. It manages fetching photo data, generating ETags for cache validation, and setting appropriate HTTP headers for responses.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoController
classes.description: Controller class for handling Buzz photo requests, including retrieving photos, cache validation via ETags, and setting HTTP response headers.

methods.name: generateBuzzPhotoETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for storing ETag data specific to a Buzz photo based on its ID.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process incoming HTTP requests, retrieve the photo, handle conditional GET via ETag, and prepare the response.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets standard HTTP headers for the response, including Content-Type, caching directives, and cache control.
